fields.name: IMO
fields.label: Vessel (IMO Number)
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The unique 7-digit identification number assigned to the ship by the International Maritime Organization (IMO) for safety, security, and environmental tracking. Mandatory for compliance under both EU MRV and IMO DCS reporting frameworks.

fields.name: Date_UTC
fields.label: Date
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) date on which the reported maritime event or log abstract entry occurred. Standardizes time records across varying time zones for global verification schemes.

fields.name: Time_UTC
fields.label: Time
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The exact Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) timestamp of the reported log entry, establishing an absolute chronological timeline for voyage analysis and regulatory validation.

fields.name: Period_Event_Type
fields.label: Period Message Type
fields.relevance: optional input
fields.description: Indicates whether the data line marks the 'Start' or the 'End' of a discrete monitoring period or specific operational phase (e.g., separating sea passage from port stay blocks).

fields.name: Previous_Port_of_Call
fields.label: Previous Port of Call
fields.relevance: optional input
fields.description: The 5-letter UN/LOCODE of the last commercial port called for cargo or passenger operations as defined under EU MRV regulations. Includes provisions for preceding transshipment ports where mandated.

fields.name: Previous_Port_of_Call_FuelEU
fields.label: Previous Port of Call (FuelEU)
fields.relevance: optional input
fields.description: The 5-letter UN/LOCODE of the previous port of call specifically categorized under the FuelEU Maritime regulation, establishing geographical boundaries for calculating voyage greenhouse gas intensity.

fields.name: Next_Port_of_Call
fields.label: Next Port of Call
fields.relevance: optional input
fields.description: The 5-letter UN/LOCODE of the vessel's subsequent scheduled commercial destination port for loading or discharging cargo/passengers, serving as a boundary for MRV voyage mapping.

fields.name: Next_Port_of_Call_FuelEU
fields.label: Next Port of Call (FuelEU)
fields.relevance: optional input
fields.description: The 5-letter UN/LOCODE of the next destination port evaluated under FuelEU Maritime rules, determining whether the upcoming transit constitutes an intra-EU voyage or a voyage originating/terminating outside the EU.

fields.name: Voyage_From
fields.label: Voyage From
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The 5-letter UN/LOCODE designating the port of departure for the current specific voyage leg being reported under standard MRV and DCS metrics.

fields.name: Voyage_To
fields.label: Voyage To
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The 5-letter UN/LOCODE designating the port of arrival for the current reported voyage leg, indicating the official end of the monitoring segment.

fields.name: Voyage_Type
fields.label: Voyage type
fields.relevance: for CII correction
fields.description: Classification of the voyage type (e.g., 'STS' for Ship-to-Ship, one-way, round trip, or idle). Essential for applying operational correction factors to Carbon Intensity Indicator (CII) calculations.

fields.name: Voyage_Number
fields.label: Voyage Number
fields.relevance: recommended for voyage level verfication schemes
fields.description: Alphanumeric operator-assigned identifiers tracking specific commercial voyages, ensuring cross-system compatibility with charter parties and verification schemes.

fields.name: Offhire_Reasons
fields.label: Offhire reasons
fields.relevance: for CII correction, voluntary wrt MRV
fields.description: Explicit descriptions explaining why a vessel was taken out of service (e.g., repairs, drydocking). Essential for processing deductions or exclusions under IMO GHG reporting guidelines and CII parameters.

fields.name: Event
fields.label: Event
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The distinct operational event type being logged (e.g., Arrival, Departure, BOSP, EOSP, Noon reports). This determines the data processing logic and baseline state for emissions verification.

fields.name: Mode
fields.label: Mode
fields.relevance: optional input
fields.description: High-level operational mode status of the vessel at the time of reporting (e.g., InPort, AtSea, Sailing), ensuring correct parsing of performance baselines and harbor emissions.

fields.name: Purposes_Of_Call
fields.label: Purposes of port call
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The specific objective of the port visit (e.g., Cargo Operations, Bunkering, Dry Docking). Must be provided at every Departure event to verify whether a port stay qualifies as a regulatory 'port of call' under EU MRV rules.

fields.name: Time_Since_Previous_Report
fields.label: Time Since Previous Report
fields.mandatoryNote: A value is required for Time_Since_Previous_Report only if in the associated event a distance, work or any consumption is reported. This is usually the case. However, when two events occur at the same timestamp, e.g. Arrival and Noon at the same time, one can omit the reporting of distance, work and consumption in the second event. Note, reporting events for the same time requires the reporting of Event_Id and Sort_Number.
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The net elapsed duration in hours since the immediately preceding data transmission, serving as the temporal base for all integrated consumption, work, and emissions math.

fields.name: Time_Elapsed_Sailing
fields.label: Sailing
fields.relevance: DSC only, voluntary wrt MRV
fields.description: The duration within the reporting window, measured in hours, during which the vessel was actively underway and sailing at sea (excludes maneuvering and anchoring periods).

fields.name: Time_Elapsed_Anchoring
fields.label: Time at anchor
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The duration in hours that the vessel spent at anchor during the reporting timeframe, isolated to calculate anchorage fuel patterns and emissions.

fields.name: Time_Elapsed_DP
fields.label: Dynamic positioning
fields.relevance: recommended for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The total duration in hours during which the vessel engaged its dynamic positioning (DP) systems, separating specialized offshore holding maneuvers from normal cruising.

fields.name: Time_Elapsed_Ice
fields.label: Operating in ice
fields.relevance: for CII correction, voluntary wrt MRV
fields.description: The time spent navigating through ice conditions. Can overlap with other active metrics and is critical for claiming CII operational correction factors.

fields.name: Time_Elapsed_Maneuvering
fields.label: Maneuvering
fields.relevance: recommended for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The duration in hours spent performing port approach or departure maneuvers, passing canals, or handling low-speed harbor pilot transits.

fields.name: Time_Elapsed_Waiting
fields.label: Waiting
fields.relevance: not in use
fields.description: The time spent drifting or idling outside port boundaries while waiting for berth access, high tide, or operational orders.

fields.name: Time_Elapsed_Loading_Unloading
fields.label: Loading/ Unloading
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV
fields.description: The total duration in hours spent actively performing commercial cargo loading or discharging operations while securely berthed alongside.

fields.name: Time_Elapsed_Drifting
fields.label: Drifting
fields.relevance: recommended for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The duration in hours spent drifting at sea without propulsion due to weather hold, scheduling delays, or engine optimization tasks.

fields.name: Distance
fields.label: Distance over Ground
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The absolute distance traveled over ground in Nautical Miles (NM) since the last report, typically derived via GPS. A core parameter for MRV, DCS, and CII transportation work calculations.

fields.name: Latitude_Degree
fields.label: Latitude Degrees
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The integer component of the ship's geographic latitude coordinate at the moment of logging.

fields.name: Latitude_Minutes
fields.label: Latitude Minutes
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The decimal minutes component of the vessel's geographic latitude position.

fields.name: Latitude_North_South
fields.label: Latitude North / South
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: Geographic hemisphere indicator ('N' for North, 'S' for South) clarifying the direction of the logged latitude coordinate.

fields.name: Longitude_Degree
fields.label: Longitude Degrees
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The integer component of the ship's geographic longitude coordinate at the moment of logging.

fields.name: Longitude_Minutes
fields.label: Longitude Minutes
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The decimal minutes component of the vessel's geographic longitude position.

fields.name: Longitude_East_West
fields.label: Longitude East / West
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: Geographic hemisphere indicator ('E' for East, 'W' for West) clarifying the orientation of the logged longitude coordinate.

fields.name: Cargo_Mt
fields.label: Weight of cargo in mt
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The exact total weight of commercial cargo carried onboard measured in metric tons (mt). Applicable as per ship type under Regulation (EU) 2016/1928 and MARPOL Annex VI for MRV/DCS transport work calculations.

fields.name: Deadweight_Carried
fields.label: Deadweight carried as per MRV (i.e. excl. bunkers)
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The total deadweight displacement carried on the reported leg in metric tons (mt), explicitly excluding bunkers to align with MRV regulatory definitions.

fields.name: Cargo_M3
fields.label: Volume of cargo in cubic meters
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The absolute volume of cargo carried inside the cargo tanks or holds, measured in cubic meters (m3), primarily utilized for gas carriers and chemical tankers.

fields.name: Passengers
fields.label: Number of passengers
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The headcount of ticketed passengers onboard during the voyage phase, used to calculate transport work coefficients for Ro-Pax and cruise vessels.

fields.name: Crew
fields.label: People Crew
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The total number of active shipboard crew members and officers signed onto the ship's articles during the monitored period.

fields.name: Cargo_Total_TEU
fields.label: Containers Total
fields.relevance: DSC only, voluntary wrt MRV
fields.description: The aggregate sum of all Twenty-Foot Equivalent Units (TEU) stacked onboard, combining both laden and empty containers for DCS metrics.

fields.name: Reefer_20_Chilled
fields.label: Reefer 20 ft. Chilled
fields.relevance: for CII correction
fields.description: The count of active 20-foot refrigerated containers carrying chilled cargo that draw electrical power from the ship's grids, used for CII electrical deductions.

fields.name: Reefer_40_Chilled
fields.label: Reefer 40 ft. chilled
fields.relevance: for CII correction
fields.description: The count of active 40-foot refrigerated cargo containers handling chilled cargo, isolated for auxiliary engine fuel load adjustments during emission verifications.

fields.name: Reefer_20_Frozen
fields.label: Reefer 20 ft. Frozen
fields.relevance: for CII correction
fields.description: The count of active 20-foot refrigerated cargo boxes maintaining deep-frozen temperatures, drawing higher steady-state electrical currents.

fields.name: Reefer_40_Frozen
fields.label: Reefer 40 ft. Frozen
fields.relevance: for CII correction
fields.description: The count of active 40-foot refrigerated cargo units managing frozen products, tracked to evaluate energy baseline modifications under CII rules.

fields.name: ME_Consumption_HFO
fields.label: Main Engine HFO consumption
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: The total mass in metric tons (mt) of Heavy Fuel Oil consumed exclusively by the primary Main Engines (ME). Only fuels actually used should be reported.

fields.name: ME_Consumption_LFO
fields.label: Main Engine LFO consumption
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS
fields.description: Light Fuel Oil (LFO) mass in metric tons consumed by the Main Engines within the reporting step.

fields.name: ME_Consumption_MGO
fields.label: Main Engine MGO consumption
fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS

fields.name: ME_Consumption_MDO

fields.name: ME_Consumption_LPGP

fields.name: ME_Consumption_LPGB

fields.name: ME_Consumption_LNG

fields.name: ME_Consumption_M

fields.name: ME_Consumption_E

fields.name: ME_Consumption_O

fields.name: ME_Consumption_O_type

fields.relevance: mandatory for MRV&DCS

fields.name: AE_Consumption_HFO
